sentences.text:
This application, under Section 483, BNSS is preferred by accused, namely, Wajid Hussain @
Munna, who has been languishing in jail hazot in connection with POCSO Case No. 92(T)/2024,
corresponding to Tinsukia P.S. Case No. 107/2024, under Section 376 of the IPC, read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act, pending before the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Tinsukia, for grant of bail.

Mr. Bordoloi, learned counsel for the accused that this is the second bail application preferred by the accused and the first one, being Bail Appln. No. 3748/2024, was dismissed by this Court, vide order dated 27.01.2025.

Mr. Bordoloi also submits that on account of non-examination of the crucial witnesses, the first bail application was dismissed, and that now seven witnesses have already been examined including the victim, and therefore, the accused has approached this Court again for grant of bail.
The submission of Mr. Bordoloi needs further consideration.

At this stage, let notice be issued to the respondent No. 2 through the Office of the Public Prosecutor, Gauhati High Court, Registry shall call for the scanned copy of the record from the learned trial Court.
